jobs.title: Do I need a finance background to intern at Two Sigma?
jobs.description: It’s nice to have, but more than half of Two Sigma’s employees come from outside the finance industry. If you’ve got the quantitative skills and a passion for the problems we’re solving, we can teach you the rest.

jobs.title: When should I apply for a summer internship at Two Sigma?
jobs.description: As early as possible. We post our internship applications the summer/fall prior to the program, and recruit on campus during the fall season. We receive tens of thousands of applications for our internship program, so we recommend submitting one as early as you can.

jobs.description: Our interview process consists of a combination of technical and behavioral interviews - both to assess your technical abilities and also see what you’d be like to work with.

jobs.title: Are Two Sigma internships paid, and is housing or relocation support available?

jobs.title: What are the perks and benefits I’ll get as an intern?
